findings.issue: Contract requires strict JSON rejection of non-JSON constants such as NaN and Infinity, but no 75-matrix input recipe exercises a NaN/Infinity literal line. A delivery using Python json allow_nan could accept such input and still pass F75/75.
findings.required_change: Add explicit finite input recipes for NaN and Infinity literals (e.g. quantity NaN, bare NaN line) with expected error, before any registration/authors, preserving all 60/63/68/73 originals and updating counts/hashes/controls.

findings.issue: Held-open PIPE probe (2.5s supervisor, outer 3s cap) detects blocking read before --help validation but cannot detect non-blocking fd0 introspection such as poll/select or O_NONBLOCK read that returns immediately then errors. Contract states error before reading stdin without qualifying blocking-only.
findings.required_change: Strengthen ordering proof to exclude any fd0 read/poll (e.g. closed-stdin variant, syscall tracing, or seccomp observation) or narrow the contractual claim explicitly to blocking reads and bind that narrowed claim in contract/protocol/judge before freeze.

review.oracle_audit: Audited contract.md vs reserved.py 75 recipes groups 11/10/10/13/12/19 with 2 publics; original60 generator source SHA a5c8d9ea preserved and canonical60 data SHA be25952e matched by hermetic test; judge enforces exit 0/2, empty stdout/stderr framing, strict_json_loads, typed equality, pretty/key-order tolerance, and timeout/truncation/infrastructure handling; added legal-no-final-LF, types cr-escape/lf-escape/raw-NUL, boundaries id-65/site-65/move-from-to-64/move-from-65/move-to-65/empty-lot/empty-site/empty-from/empty-to, and format argv-with-payload/argv-before-stdin preserve all prior IDs; source closure 48 files bound, import closure and identity/public-packet/original60/argv checks present; 113 hermetic checks and 29 synthetic controls verify framing/isolation/replay/order probes, not domain-oracle proof or field efficacy. Remaining gaps: no NaN/Infinity input oracle; argv probe limited to blocking reads as disclosed.
review.rationale: Revise because two concrete pre-registration oracle/control gaps remain despite 48-file self-contained 113-pass receipt and 29 synthetic controls: missing NaN/Infinity input coverage permits a non-compliant pass, and the argv ordering probe proves only blocking-read ordering.
